title: Requesting prices from suppliers
scene: NPS needs 120 lithium battery modules for the Horizon Hospital UPS project and Q4 stock. The Finance Director asks you to get offers from three suppliers. You send an RFQ to Shenzhen VoltTech, but their reply is not what you asked for.
sceneAr: الشركة محتاجة 120 موديول بطارية ليثيوم لمشروع ‎UPS‎ مستشفى حورايزون، والمدير المالي طالب عروض من 3 موردين. إنت بعت ‎RFQ‎ لـ ‎VoltTech‎ بس ردهم جه ناقص ومش بالشروط اللي طلبتها.

thread.subject: Lithium battery modules for Q4 projects
body: Hi,
We need 120 lithium battery modules (51.2V 100Ah) for the Horizon Hospital UPS project and our Q4 stock. Please send an RFQ to at least three suppliers this week.
Ask for CFR Alexandria prices, lead time, warranty and payment terms. Also check the MOQ, because some factories only sell full pallets.
I want a comparison sheet on my desk by Thursday, 18 September.

Thanks,
Hany Zaki
Finance Director

thread.subject: RFQ – 120 x LiFePO4 battery modules 51.2V 100Ah
thread.task: ابعت ‎RFQ‎ واضح لـ ‎Mr. Wang‎: المواصفات، الكمية، شرط التسليم ‎CFR‎ إسكندرية، واطلب مدة التوريد والضمان وشروط الدفع والشهادات.

steps.q: Choose the best line to request the offer
opts: Please send me your prices quickly.
I want to ask about the price of batteries if possible.
We would like to receive your best offer for the following item:
steps.why: الجملة التالتة مهذبة ومباشرة؛ الأولى ناشفة والتانية مترجمة من العربي.

steps.sentence: Please quote CFR Alexandria and confirm the ___ time, warranty period, MOQ and payment terms.
steps.why: ‎lead time‎ هو المصطلح المعروف لمدة التصنيع والتوريد.

parts: I hope you are well.
We would like to receive your best offer for the following item:
Please also send the datasheet, MSDS and UN38.3 test report.
We would appreciate your offer by Thursday, 11 September.
steps.why: تحية ← الطلب ← المستندات المطلوبة ← آخر ميعاد للرد.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
I hope you are well. We would like to receive your best offer for the following item:
120 x LiFePO4 rack battery modules, 51.2V 100Ah, with built-in BMS and RS485/CAN communication. The modules will be used with 60 kVA UPS systems.
Please quote CFR Alexandria and confirm the lead time, warranty period, MOQ and payment terms. Please also send the datasheet, MSDS and UN38.3 test report.
We would appreciate your offer by Thursday, 11 September.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: RE: RFQ – 120 x LiFePO4 battery modules 51.2V 100Ah
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for your inquiry. Our price for model VT-LFP51100 is USD 1,080 per unit, FOB Shenzhen. Lead time is 35 days after we receive the deposit.
Payment terms are 30% deposit by T/T and 70% before shipment. The warranty is 3 years. Please find the datasheet attached.
Please let us know if you need anything else.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

thread.subject: RE: RFQ – 120 x LiFePO4 battery modules 51.2V 100Ah
thread.task: المورد سعّر ‎FOB‎ مش ‎CFR‎ ونسي الـ ‎MSDS‎ وتقرير ‎UN38.3‎. اطلب منه بأدب يعدّل العرض ويبعت الشهادات، واسأل عن الـ ‎MOQ‎ وضمان 5 سنين.

steps.q: How do you point out the supplier's mistake politely?
opts: However, we asked for a CFR Alexandria price, not FOB Shenzhen.
You made a mistake, we said CFR.
Why did you send FOB? Please read my email again.
steps.why: ‎However‎ + توضيح الطلب من غير لوم؛ الباقي فيه اتهام للمورد.

steps.sentence: Could you please revise your offer to include sea ___ to Alexandria port?
steps.why: ‎sea freight‎ = الشحن البحري، وهو اللي بيفرق بين ‎FOB‎ و ‎CFR‎.

parts: Thank you for your quick reply and the datasheet.
However, we asked for a CFR Alexandria price, not FOB Shenzhen.
Also, please send the MSDS and UN38.3 test report.
Finally, could you confirm the MOQ and whether a 5-year warranty is possible?
steps.why: شكر ← المشكلة الأساسية ← المستندات الناقصة ← أسئلة إضافية بـ ‎Finally‎.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your quick reply and the datasheet.
However, we asked for a CFR Alexandria price, not FOB Shenzhen. Could you please revise your offer to include sea freight to Alexandria port?
Also, please send the MSDS and UN38.3 test report. Without them, we cannot clear lithium batteries at Egyptian customs.
Finally, could you confirm the MOQ and whether a 5-year warranty is possible?

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: We would like to receive your best offer for …
حابين نستلم أحسن عرض عندكم لـ …
Please confirm the lead time and payment terms
ياريت تأكد مدة التوريد وشروط الدفع
We would appreciate your offer by …
هنكون شاكرين لو العرض وصل قبل …
Thank you for your quick reply
Could you please revise your offer to include …
glossary: شروط التسليم الدولية: تسليم ظهر المركب / شامل الشحن
تقرير اختبار أمان نقل بطاريات الليثيوم

title: Comparing offers & negotiating
scene: You now have three offers. VoltTech quotes USD 1,080 CFR Alexandria with a 3-year warranty, while Ningbo HexaCell quotes USD 1,020 but needs 55 days and an MOQ of 200. You prefer VoltTech's quality, so you negotiate the price and warranty, then place the order.
sceneAr: معاك 3 عروض. ‎VoltTech‎ بـ 1,080 دولار وضمان 3 سنين، و ‎Ningbo HexaCell‎ أرخص بس التوريد 55 يوم وأقل كمية 200. إنت عايز ‎VoltTech‎ عشان الجودة، فهتفاوض على السعر والضمان وبعدين تبعت أمر الشراء.

thread.subject: Revised offer VT-2025-0912 – price and warranty
thread.task: فاوض ‎Mr. Wang‎: قوله إن سعره أعلى من أرخص عرض، واطلب 1,030 دولار وضمان 5 سنين، واقترح دفع 30% مقدم و70% مقابل صورة البوليصة.

steps.q: Choose the best way to ask for a discount
opts: Your price is too expensive, give us a discount.
Can you make it cheaper for us please my friend?
We prefer your quality, but we need a better price.
steps.why: بتمدح الجودة وبتطلب سعر أحسن باحترافية؛ الباقي ناشف أو كاجوال زيادة.

steps.sentence: If you can offer USD 1,030 per unit with a 5-year warranty, we are ready to ___ an order for 120 units this week.
steps.why: بنقول ‎place an order‎ مش ‎make/do an order‎.

parts: Thank you for your revised offer VT-2025-0912 at USD 1,080 per unit, CFR Alexandria.
We prefer your quality, but we need a better price.
If you can offer USD 1,030 per unit with a 5-year warranty, we are ready to place an order for 120 units this week.
We also propose 30% deposit and 70% against a copy of the B/L.
steps.why: شكر ← سبب التفاوض ← العرض بتاعك ← شروط الدفع.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your revised offer VT-2025-0912 at USD 1,080 per unit, CFR Alexandria.
We are comparing three offers, and your price is about 6% higher than the lowest one. We prefer your quality, but we need a better price.
If you can offer USD 1,030 per unit with a 5-year warranty, we are ready to place an order for 120 units this week.
We also propose 30% deposit and 70% against a copy of the B/L.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: RE: Revised offer VT-2025-0912 – price and warranty
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for your interest. USD 1,030 is below our cost, but we can offer USD 1,045 per unit with a 5-year warranty.
We accept 30% deposit and 70% against a copy of the B/L. Please note that the MOQ for this price is 120 units.
Lead time is still 35 days after we receive the deposit.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

thread.subject: RE: Revised offer VT-2025-0912 – price and warranty
thread.task: اقترح حل وسط 1,040 دولار، وقوله إنك هتبعت أمر الشراء النهارده والمقدم خلال 5 أيام عمل من استلام الفاتورة المبدئية.

steps.q: How do you suggest a compromise?
opts: OK, final price 1,040, take it or leave it.
Let's meet in the middle: USD 1,040 per unit.
We will split the difference if you want or not.
steps.why: ‎meet in the middle‎ تعبير ودود ومعروف للحل الوسط؛ الأول تهديد والتالت ركيك.

steps.sentence: If you agree, we will issue the purchase ___ today and send the deposit within five working days of receiving your proforma invoice.
steps.why: ‎purchase order (PO)‎ = أمر الشراء.

parts: Thank you for your flexibility.
Let's meet in the middle: USD 1,040 per unit, CFR Alexandria, 5-year warranty, for 120 units.
Please confirm by reply.
steps.why: شكر ← الاقتراح النهائي ← طلب تأكيد.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your flexibility. We are very close now.
Let's meet in the middle: USD 1,040 per unit, CFR Alexandria, 5-year warranty, for 120 units. This gives a total of USD 124,800.
If you agree, we will issue the purchase order today and send the deposit within five working days of receiving your proforma invoice.
Please confirm by reply.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: RE: Revised offer VT-2025-0912 – price and warranty
body: Dear <Your name>,
Agreed. USD 1,040 per unit, CFR Alexandria, 5-year warranty, 120 units, total USD 124,800.
Our production team has already reserved the cells for your order. Delivery will be 35 days after we receive the deposit, as discussed.
Please send your purchase order, and we will issue the proforma invoice on the same day.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

thread.subject: PO-2025-164 – 120 x VT-LFP51100 lithium battery modules
thread.task: ابعت أمر الشراء ‎PO-2025-164‎ واطلب الفاتورة المبدئية فيها بيانات البنك والـ ‎HS code‎ والأوزان، واطلب تأكيد ميعاد الشحن.

steps.q: Choose the best line to send the PO
opts: I send you the order in the attachment.
Please find attached our purchase order PO-2025-164.
steps.why: ‎Please find attached‎ هي الصيغة المعتادة لإرسال مرفق.

steps.sentence: Kindly send us your ___ invoice with your bank details, HS code and net and gross weights.
steps.why: قبل الشحن بنطلب ‎proforma invoice‎؛ الـ ‎commercial invoice‎ بتيجي مع الشحنة.

parts: Thank you for confirming.
Please find attached our purchase order PO-2025-164 for 120 x VT-LFP51100 modules, total USD 124,800, CFR Alexandria.
Our bank needs these details to process the deposit.
Please also confirm the expected shipment date.
steps.why: شكر ← المرفق ← سبب طلب البيانات ← طلب أخير.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for confirming. Please find attached our purchase order PO-2025-164 for 120 x VT-LFP51100 modules, total USD 124,800, CFR Alexandria.
Kindly send us your proforma invoice with your bank details, HS code and net and gross weights. Our bank needs these details to process the deposit.
Please also confirm the expected shipment date.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: We prefer your quality, but we need a better price.
بنفضّل جودتكم، بس محتاجين سعر أحسن.
We are ready to place an order
Please find attached our purchase order
glossary: against a copy of the B/L

title: Bank forms & payment
scene: Nadia from Accounts tries to transfer the 30% deposit, but the bank rejects the proforma invoice. After the supplier corrects it, the money is sent, but the supplier receives USD 45 less because of bank charges. You fix both problems without delaying production.
sceneAr: نادية في الحسابات حاولت تحوّل الـ 30% مقدم والبنك رفض الفاتورة المبدئية. وبعد ما اتصلحت واتحولت الفلوس، المورد استلم 45 دولار أقل بسبب مصاريف البنك. لازم تحل المشكلتين من غير ما الإنتاج يتأخر.

thread.subject: Deposit for PO-2025-164 – bank needs documents
body: Hi <Your name>,
I submitted the transfer request for the 30% deposit (USD 37,440) to our bank this morning, together with the import form. The bank rejected it for two reasons.
First, the proforma invoice is not signed or stamped by the supplier. Second, the beneficiary name on the PI is 'Shenzhen Volt Tech Co.', but the bank account name is 'Shenzhen VoltTech Co., Ltd.'
Please get a corrected PI today so we can resubmit tomorrow.

Thanks,
Nadia Hassan
Chief Accountant

thread.subject: PI-VT-250918 – corrections needed for bank transfer
thread.task: اطلب من ‎Mr. Wang‎ فاتورة مبدئية معدّلة: موقّعة ومختومة، واسم المستفيد مطابق لاسم الحساب بالظبط.

steps.q: Explain the problem without blaming the supplier
opts: Your PI is wrong, so the bank refused it.
The bank is angry because of your mistakes.
Unfortunately, our bank could not process the deposit because of two issues.
steps.why: ‎Unfortunately‎ + وصف المشكلة بشكل محايد من غير اتهام.

steps.sentence: The PI is not signed or stamped, and the beneficiary name does not ___ the bank account name exactly.
steps.why: ‎match‎ فعل؛ ‎same‎ و ‎equal‎ مش مناسبين هنا.

parts: Thank you for your proforma invoice PI-VT-250918.
Unfortunately, our bank could not process the deposit because of two issues.
Could you please send a corrected, signed and stamped PI today?
We will transfer the deposit as soon as we receive it.
steps.why: شكر ← المشكلة ← الطلب ← الخطوة الجاية من عندك.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your proforma invoice PI-VT-250918. Unfortunately, our bank could not process the deposit because of two issues.
The PI is not signed or stamped, and the beneficiary name does not match the bank account name exactly. It should read 'Shenzhen VoltTech Co., Ltd.'
Could you please send a corrected, signed and stamped PI today? We will transfer the deposit as soon as we receive it.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: RE: PI-VT-250918 – corrections needed for bank transfer
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the transfer. However, our bank received USD 37,395, which is USD 45 less than the deposit amount. It seems the intermediary bank deducted its charges.
According to our PI, all bank charges outside China are for the buyer's account. Could you please transfer the USD 45 difference? We can then start production.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

thread.subject: RE: PI-VT-250918 – corrections needed for bank transfer
thread.task: اعترف إن التحويل اتعمل ‎SHA‎ بالغلط، واقترح تضيف الـ 45 دولار على الدفعة الأخيرة وتبعتها ‎OUR‎، واطلب إنه يبدأ الإنتاج.

steps.q: How do you accept responsibility?
opts: You are right, the transfer was sent with SHA charges by mistake.
It's not our fault, the bank took the money.
Maybe yes, maybe no. We will check.
steps.why: بتعترف بالغلط بوضوح وده بيبني ثقة؛ التانية بتهرب من المسؤولية.

steps.sentence: The balance will then be USD 87,405, and we will send it with ___ charges so you receive the full amount.
steps.why: ‎OUR‎ = الراسل بيدفع كل المصاريف فالمستفيد بيستلم المبلغ كامل.

parts: Thank you for letting us know.
To avoid delaying production, we suggest adding the USD 45 to the balance payment.
Please confirm that you can start production on this basis.
steps.why: شكر ← الحل المقترح ← طلب التأكيد.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for letting us know. You are right, the transfer was sent with SHA charges by mistake.
To avoid delaying production, we suggest adding the USD 45 to the balance payment. The balance will then be USD 87,405, and we will send it with OUR charges so you receive the full amount.
Please confirm that you can start production on this basis.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: RE: PI-VT-250918 – corrections needed for bank transfer
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for your quick solution. We agree to add the USD 45 to the balance payment of USD 87,405.
Production of your 120 modules starts tomorrow, 26 September. We expect the goods to be ready on 20 October, and we will send you photos before packing.
We will keep you updated about the shipping booking.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

phrases: Our bank could not process the payment because …
We will transfer the deposit as soon as we receive it.
Thank you for letting us know.
To avoid delaying production, we suggest …
glossary: توزيع مصاريف التحويل بين الراسل والمستفيد

title: Pre-shipment & import registration
scene: The batteries will be ready on 20 October. Under Egypt's ACI system, you must pre-register the shipment on Nafeza and the supplier must upload the documents on CargoX. The supplier's draft invoice and packing list contain errors that could cause fines at Alexandria port.
sceneAr: البطاريات هتجهز 20 أكتوبر. بنظام ‎ACI‎ لازم تسجّل الشحنة مسبقاً على نافذة، والمورد يرفع المستندات على ‎CargoX‎. بس مسودة الفاتورة وقائمة التعبئة فيهم أخطاء ممكن تعمل غرامات في ميناء إسكندرية.

thread.subject: ACID number for PO-2025-164 – please register on CargoX
thread.task: ابعت لـ ‎Mr. Wang‎ رقم الـ ‎ACID‎، وقوله لازم يتكتب على الفاتورة وقائمة التعبئة والبوليصة، واطلب يبعت المسودات قبل ما يرفعها على ‎CargoX‎.

steps.q: Choose the clearest sentence
opts: We made the Nafeza thing for the shipment.
The shipment is registered in Nafeza by us already done.
We have pre-registered the shipment on Nafeza.
steps.why: جملة قصيرة وواضحة بالمصطلح الصح ‎pre-registered‎.

steps.sentence: Please make sure this ACID number ___ on the commercial invoice, packing list and bill of lading.
steps.why: ‎appears on‎ = يكون مكتوب على المستند.

parts: As the goods will be ready on 20 October, we have pre-registered the shipment on Nafeza.
Please make sure this ACID number appears on the commercial invoice, packing list and bill of lading.
Customs in Egypt will reject any document without it.
steps.why: إيه اللي عملته ← المطلوب منه ← ليه ده مهم.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
As the goods will be ready on 20 October, we have pre-registered the shipment on Nafeza. Our ACID number is 4412587632025100087.
Please make sure this ACID number appears on the commercial invoice, packing list and bill of lading. Customs in Egypt will reject any document without it.
Please also upload the final documents on CargoX before shipment, but send us the drafts first for checking.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: RE: ACID number for PO-2025-164 – please register on CargoX
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the ACID number. We are already registered on CargoX. Please find attached the draft commercial invoice CI-VT-251014 and the packing list for your review.
The goods will be packed on 8 pallets. The total gross weight is 3,960 kg.
We will upload the documents as soon as you approve them.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

thread.subject: RE: ACID number for PO-2025-164 – please register on CargoX
thread.task: راجع المسودات واطلب 3 تصحيحات: رقم الـ ‎ACID‎ ناقص من قائمة التعبئة، الـ ‎HS code‎ غلط، والوزن القائم مختلف بين المستندين.

steps.q: How do you introduce a list of corrections?
opts: There are many mistakes, fix them:
Before you upload them on CargoX, please correct the following points:
Kindly find the below mistakes to be corrected by you:
steps.why: مهذبة وبتوضح التوقيت (قبل الرفع)؛ التالتة ترجمة حرفية تقيلة.

steps.sentence: The documents must match exactly, or we may face fines and ___ at Alexandria port.
steps.why: ‎delays‎ هي الكلمة الطبيعية للتأخير في الشحن والجمارك.

parts: Thank you for the drafts.
Before you upload them on CargoX, please correct the following points:
The documents must match exactly, or we may face fines and delays at Alexandria port.
steps.why: شكر ← قائمة التصحيحات ← النتيجة لو ما اتصلحتش.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for the drafts. Before you upload them on CargoX, please correct the following points:
1. The ACID number is missing from the packing list.
2. The HS code on the invoice is 8506.50; it should be 8507.60 for lithium-ion accumulators.
3. The gross weight is 3,960 kg on the invoice but 3,690 kg on the packing list.
The documents must match exactly, or we may face fines and delays at Alexandria port.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: RE: ACID number for PO-2025-164 – please register on CargoX
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for checking. We have corrected all three points. The correct gross weight is 3,960 kg; the packing list had a typing error.
The final commercial invoice and packing list are now uploaded on CargoX under your ACID number. The booking is confirmed on a vessel leaving Shekou on 22 October.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

thread.subject: RE: ACID number for PO-2025-164 – please register on CargoX
thread.task: أكّد إن المستندات ظهرت مظبوطة على نافذة، واطلب مسودة البوليصة قبل إصدارها، وفكّره بعلامات البضاعة الخطرة ‎UN3480‎.

steps.q: Choose the best confirmation
opts: Documents are okay now I think.
We saw the documents, it is matching all.
We can now see the documents on Nafeza, and everything matches.
steps.why: واضحة وصحيحة لغوياً؛ التانية فيها غلط في القواعد.

steps.sentence: Could you please send us the ___ bill of lading before the shipping line issues it?
steps.why: ‎draft B/L‎ = مسودة البوليصة للمراجعة قبل الإصدار.

parts: Thank you for the quick corrections.
Could you please send us the draft bill of lading before the shipping line issues it?
Please also mark the cartons as UN3480, Class 9, as required for lithium batteries.
steps.why: شكر ← الطلب الرئيسي ← طلب إضافي بـ ‎Please also‎.

body: Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for the quick corrections. We can now see the documents on Nafeza, and everything matches.
Could you please send us the draft bill of lading before the shipping line issues it? We need to check the consignee name, the ACID number and the description of goods.
Please also mark the cartons as UN3480, Class 9, as required for lithium batteries.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Purchasing Officer | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: We have pre-registered the shipment on Nafeza.
Please send us the drafts first for checking.

title: Receiving the bill of lading
scene: The supplier sent the original B/L by DHL, but the envelope is stuck in Hong Kong. The vessel arrives in Alexandria on 18 November, and without the original B/L you cannot get the delivery order. You follow up and arrange a telex release.
sceneAr: المورد بعت البوليصة الأصلية بـ ‎DHL‎ بس الظرف واقف في هونج كونج. المركب واصلة إسكندرية 18 نوفمبر، ومن غير البوليصة الأصلية مش هتعرف تطلع إذن التسليم. هتتابع مع المورد وتطلب ‎telex release‎.

thread.from: Mr. Wang Lei — Shenzhen VoltTech Co.
thread.subject: PO-2025-164 – original documents sent by DHL
body: Dear <Your name>,
Thank you for the balance payment of USD 87,405, which we received in full.
Today we sent the original documents by DHL, AWB 7738 2215 904. The set includes 3 original B/Ls, the commercial invoice, the packing list and the certificate of origin.
The vessel ETA at Alexandria is 18 November. Please let us know when you receive the envelope.

Best regards,
Wang Lei
Export Sales | Shenzhen VoltTech Co.

thread.subject: RE: PO-2025-164 – original documents sent by DHL
thread.task: المستندات ما وصلتش والمركب قربت. تابع بأدب واطلب يكلّم ‎DHL‎، ولو مش هتوصل قبل 16 نوفمبر هتطلب ‎telex release‎.

steps.q: Choose the best follow-up opening
opts: Where are the documents? We didn't receive anything.
We are still waiting for the original documents sent on 30 October.
Documents did not come until now, why?
